scripts.dev: npm run build && npm run dev -w @dappfence/test-app
scripts.dev:http: npm run build && npm run dev:http -w @dappfence/test-app
scripts.build:watch: npm run build:watch -w @dappfence/core & npm run build:watch -w @dappfence/test-app
scripts.lint: eslint packages/ --fix && npm run --prefix examples lint
scripts.check: prettier --check "*.md" packages/ && eslint packages/ && npm run --prefix examples check
scripts.format: prettier --write "*.md" packages/ && npm run --prefix examples format
scripts.publish:core: npm run check && npm run build:prod && npm publish -w @dappfence/core --access public
scripts.prepare: npm run check && npm run build:prod
